message: Creating superpowers-format implementation plan for the Knowledge Absorption Curve study (5 phases). Chose a single comprehensive plan over separate sub-plans because phases have sequential dependencies with decision points — Phase 2 depends on Phase 1's crossover, Phase 3 depends on Phase 2's winner, Phase 5 depends on all prior data. Phase 0 tooling gets full TDD treatment; experiment phases get structured GPU-run tasks with statistical verification checkpoints.
